ai_analysis.competitive_effect: Serves as a positive institutional endorsement relative to banking peers, though operational competitive dynamics for loan and deposit market share remain unaffected.

ai_analysis.medium_long_term: Long-term trajectory remains dependent on core banking fundamentals, including post-merger integration, deposit growth, and asset quality, rather than fund-level position changes.
